sources.beginner: hand-calc from closed forms taught in beginner m02-m04 (Sv/Pp at 2000 m printed in full at m02/l05:32); StressExplorer Profile (k0, q at 8 dp) and UCS view (MPa at 5 dp) also reach fields 1, 2, 5, 6
sources.intermediate: unobtainable: engine wellboreStability (theta scan + bisection); StabilityExplorer.jsx:33 runs published PARAMS and profile UCS only, so the capstone case cannot be set
sources.advanced: unobtainable: mudWindowAlongWell walk; WindowExplorer.jsx:29 takes only nu, friction angle and SHmax azimuth (no E, strains, Biot, tensile strength), and has no collapse-at-tightest tile

fields.evidence: k0 = nu/(1-nu) = 0.24/0.76 = 0.3157894736842105, reproduced exactly. The stress explorer Profile view also takes Poisson ratio 0.24 and prints 'k0 used' with fmt(s.k0Used, 8), which clears tol 5e-7.
fields.notes: Two routes, both fine: hand-calc (full precision) or StressExplorer.jsx:74 at 8 decimals.

fields.evidence: q = (1+sin 26)/(1-sin 26) = 2.5610706048410408, reproduced. Profile view friction angle input prints 'Frictional ratio q' with fmt(..., 8), clears tol 5e-7.

Sv 45110590 Pa and Pp 22015929.25 Pa at 2000 m are printed in full at beginner m02/l05:32; k0 x (Sv - 0.9 Pp) + 0.9 Pp + E/(1-nu^2)(epsX + nu epsY) reproduces 33914681.28858234 exactly; frictional bounds 29.69 to 84.60 MPa, not clamped.
fields.notes: The panel cannot run it (StressExplorer Point view is published params only; the strain multiplier cannot hit 0.0002/0.0005 and E, Biot are not inputs). Using the Point view's 5-decimal MPa Sv/Pp instead would move the answer about 0.5 Pa, well inside tol 50.

fields.evidence: Sv 45110590 Pa and Pp 22015929.25 Pa at 2000 m are printed in full at beginner m02/l05:32; k0 x (Sv - 0.9 Pp) + 0.9 Pp + E/(1-nu^2)(epsY + nu epsX) reproduces 38269519.99825976 exactly; frictional bounds 29.69 to 84.60 MPa, not clamped.
fields.notes: Same route as Shmin; not clamped.

fields.evidence: 0.77 x (1000/233)^3.2 MPa = 81461382.793438 Pa, reproduced. The UCS view takes any slowness and prints MPa(out.h) = fmt(v/1e6, 5), a 10 Pa step, max rounding error 5 Pa against tol 50.
fields.notes: Also nextgen-panel (StressExplorer.jsx:160, 5 decimals in MPa, display_scale 1e-6). No probe leak: default slowness is 250.

fields.evidence: 1200 exp(-0.036 x 233 x 0.3048) MPa = 93075820.554428 Pa, reproduced. Panel prints fmt(v/1e6, 5) MPa, error at most 5 Pa against tol 50.

fields.recommendation: Display fix: the lesson (intermediate m06/l02) sends the learner to gm-stability-explorer, but its Point view calls stability() with the published PARAMS and the profile UCS only, so the capstone case cannot be set. Letting the learner type the parameters is not a leak (they must enter them). The deviated collapse is a 1-degree theta scan plus bisection, so hand-calc is not an alternative. Existing print precision already clears every tol once the case can be set.
